input.description: The folder with your original images and videos, relative to this file.

out.description: The output folder, relative to this file. Default: a sibling of the input named <input>-web.

publicPath.description: The URL the output folder is served at, such as /media or https://cdn.example.com/media. Used in the markup, the manifest and the components. Without it, paths are relative to the output folder.

widths.description: Rendition widths in pixels. Never upscaled: the largest is capped at each source's width.

only.description: Process only images or only videos.

markup.description: The style of webready.html: srcset (the browser picks by slot width and screen density), media (by viewport width) or none (manifest only).

concurrency.description: Images encoded in parallel. Default: the number of CPU cores.

format.description: avif, webp, or both — the first is preferred, the last is the fallback and the video poster format.

quality.description: 1–100: one number for every format, or one per format. AVIF 60 and WebP 80 look about the same.

effort.description: Encoder effort: higher is smaller and slower. AVIF uses 0–9, WebP 0–6 (higher values are capped).

lossless.description: Lossless images — rarely worth it for the web.

preset.description: x264 preset: slower presets make smaller files at the same quality.

poster.description: Make a poster image for each video.
